title: Great!
text:
We did this walk under the guidance of Marta. She speaks very good English and tells all sorts of stories about Sacromonte and Albaicín in a fluent and very interesting way. Specially for us, they also paired the book of The Seven Sisters here; Moon up.
If we ever come to Granada again, Marta will definitely be our guide!
author: Ina_G

title: Must Do Tour
text: We had a wonderful informative tour of the Alhambra with Matías.  His knowledge and charisma made the tour very fun and we learned a great deal about the history of the Alhambra.  Matías’ enthusiasm and passion about the subject matter made the tour exceptionally memorable. It  be is a must do!
